title: 第 3 章 拆穿魔尊男主的伪装
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“怎么说话还一个字一个字往外蹦？”百里魇嫌弃道，抬手在昭杺柠眼前挥了挥：“人类，你能说句完整的话吗？”

“昭杺柠，我就知道垃圾广告链接不要乱点。”

讨伐型昭杺柠不光讨伐系统，还讨伐曾经乱点广告的自己。

“我又不是魔族，凭什么让我去给你魔族当仙门的卧底。”昭杺柠满脸拒绝。

对于这个魔尊保镖，认识了以后，昭杺柠很失望。

她甩手就准备转身溜人，又被百里魇一把拽了回去。

“大哥，我跟你认识吗？”

昭杺柠回头反问，一边提前点开庇护所准备跑路，一边威胁道：“你想卧底仙门我不管，但你再跟我拉拉扯扯，我就喊人了，我喊这里有个魔藏着！”

“这里可是仙门的地界，你看他们待会儿将你砍成臊子。”

“你喊呗。”面对昭杺柠的威胁，百里魇反而还有些期待。

他拉着昭杺柠手腕的手一个翻转，一条紧紧链接两人手腕的红线就显现出来。

再就是百里魇幸灾乐祸的声音：“我们手上这道红线是天道姻缘线，除非双方同意，不然姻缘线无法解开。”

“你说……要是让仙门知道你的姻缘对象是魔族，他们能放你一命吗？”

“什……什么姻缘线啊？”昭杺柠大惊。

“我刚刚就想问了，天道姻缘线是什么？”昭杺柠这话既是问百里魇的，也是问系统的。

“两年前，天道降下的姻缘线，本尊在魔界寻了你两年，倒是没想到你居然是人类。”百里魇沉声。

【宿主……穿越前连连看小游戏，你用什么颜色的线链接你和男主们的？】

“红色的线啊。”昭杺柠回答。

系统直接在她脑中发出尖锐的鸣叫：

【你为什么要用红线连！谁让你换线的颜色的！】

【黑线是追杀，红线是姻缘线，宿主，你换线了，还怎么完成星灵大陆逃生大挑战，还怎么让六个男主追杀你啊！】

面对系统崩溃的质问，昭杺柠眨巴眨巴眼，话音喜悦：“所以我不需要再去招惹男主被男主追杀了呗。”

【想得美，我可是惹祸系统，你和六个男主绑姻缘线又怎么了，想要复活回蓝星，你的任务依旧是被男主追杀】

系统初心不改，只想带着昭杺柠在星灵大陆惹事闯祸。

虽然系统给出的任务，依旧是被男主们追杀。

但是昭杺柠从刚刚系统知道她将追杀的黑线变成天道姻缘的红线以后的暴躁反应，也意识到天道姻缘线或许是她可以利用的一点。

Page (1/3)

"How come you keep spouting off each word when you speak?" Baili Xiang said in disgust, raising his hand and waving it in front of Zhao Hao Ning's eyes: "Human, can you say a complete sentence?"

"Zhao Hao Ning, I know not to mess with spammy advertising links."

The crusading Zhao Hao Ning not only crusades against the system, but also crusade against himself who once clicked ads randomly.

"I'm not a demon, why should I be the undercover agent of the Immortal Sect for your demons?" Zhao Hao Ning refused with a face full of rejection.

After getting to know this demon king's bodyguard, Zhao Hao Ning was very disappointed.

She waved her hand and was about to turn around and escape, but Baili Xiang pulled her back again.

"Brother, do I know you?"

Zhao Hao Ning turned back and asked, while opening the shelter in advance and preparing to run away, she threatened: "I don't care if you want to go undercover in the Immortal Sect, but if you keep trying to mess with me, I will call someone, and I will shout that there is a demon hiding here!"

"This is the realm of the Immortal Sect. You see, they will chop you into pieces later."

"Shout." Faced with Zhao Hao Ning's threat, Baili Xiang still had some expectations.

He turned the hand holding Zhao Haoning's wrist, and a red line connecting their wrists appeared.

Then there was the gloating voice of Baili Nightmare: "The red line in our hands is the marriage line of heaven. Unless both parties agree, the marriage line cannot be untied."

"You said...if the Immortal Sect knew that your marriage partner was a demon, would they let you live?"

"Wha... what kind of marriage line?" Zhao Hao Ning was shocked.

"I just wanted to ask, what is the marriage line of heaven?" Zhao Hao Ning asked Baili Xiang as well as the system.

"Two years ago, heaven set a marriage line. I have been looking for you in the demon world for two years, but I didn't expect that you are actually a human being." Baili Nightmare said in a deep voice.

[Host...Watch the mini-game before traveling through time. What color thread did you use to connect you with the male protagonists?】

"The red thread." Zhao Hao Ning replied.

The system screamed directly in her head:

[Why do you need to use red wire to connect!Who asked you to change the color of the thread?】

[The black line is the pursuit, and the red line is the marriage line. Host, if you change the line, how can you complete the escape challenge of the Star Spirit Continent, and how can you let six male protagonists chase you!】

Faced with the question about the system collapse, Zhao Hao Ning blinked and said happily: "So I don't need to provoke the male protagonist anymore and he will be chased by him."

[It’s a nice thought, but I’m the troublemaker in the system. What’s wrong with you and the six male protagonists tying marriage strings? If you want to be resurrected and return to Blue Star, your task is still to be chased by the male protagonist]

The system has not changed its original intention, it just wants to lead Zhao Hao Ning to cause trouble in the Protoss Continent.

Although the mission given by the system is still pursued by the male protagonists.

But Zhao Haining's violent reaction after the system just learned that she would turn the black line of pursuit into the red line of heaven's marriage, also realized that the heaven's marriage line might be something she could take advantage of.
